title: imperia-cli Workspace Config
description: Configuration file consumed by imperia-cli to resolve repositories, local development services and auxiliary runtime state used by VS Code tasks. Path-like string fields may use template variables such as ${workspaceFolder} and ${configDir}.

$schema.description: Schema URI used by editors for validation and IntelliSense. The generated config points to the published imperia-cli schema.

workspace.description: Optional metadata about the current VS Code workspace.

name.description: Display name shown by the CLI UI. If omitted, imperia-cli uses the workspace folder name.

state.description: Optional paths for internal CLI state persisted between VS Code tasks.

runSelectionPath.description: Path where the selected services state is stored between the interactive selector and subsequent service-run tasks. If omitted, imperia-cli uses ${workspaceFolder}/.git/task-state/imperia-cli-run-selection.json.

repositoryTasks.description: Optional concurrency limits for repository synchronization and backend solution builds.

syncMaxConcurrentRepositories.description: Maximum number of repositories synchronized at the same time. Defaults to 1.

buildMaxConcurrentRepositories.description: Maximum number of repositories whose backend solutions are built at the same time. Defaults to 1.

repositories.description: Repositories available in the workspace. At least one repository is required.

services.description: Service commands that imperia-cli can prepare, filter from the interactive selector, and launch through VS Code tasks.

pathString.description: Absolute path or a template-based path resolved by imperia-cli. Supported template variables are ${workspaceFolder} and ${configDir}.

stringRecord.description: String-keyed map used for environment variables. Non-string primitive values are accepted and converted to strings at runtime.

cliArg.description: Single command argument. imperia-cli converts all values to strings before spawning the process.

repository.description: Repository definition used for repository synchronization, backend solution builds, and service path resolution.

key.description: Stable repository identifier referenced by services. Must be unique inside the config.

label.description: Human-friendly repository name used in progress logs and the interactive selector. Defaults to key.

root.description: Repository root folder. If a service omits cwd, imperia-cli launches it from this folder.

solutionPath.description: Path to the .sln file rebuilt by repository preparation tasks.

existenceLabel.description: Optional label used in missing-path errors instead of the generic repository name.

buildStateFileName.description: Name of the file used to track backend build state for this repository. Defaults to <key>-build.state.

buildTaskLabel.description: Label shown when imperia-cli reports repository solution build steps. Defaults to (<key>) build solution.

preflightNpmAuth.description: Preflight step that validates npm authentication before running an npm-based service.

type.description: Special step type handled by imperia-cli.

label.description: Custom label shown while validating npm authentication. Defaults to 'Validate npm authentication'.

cwd.description: Working directory used to validate npm authentication. Defaults to the parent service cwd.

preflightCommand.description: Generic preflight command executed before the service starts. Any step with a command is normalized as a command preflight step.

type.description: Optional custom type metadata. imperia-cli treats any non 'npm-auth' step with a command as a regular command step.

label.description: Label shown in progress output. Defaults to description and then command.

description.description: Fallback text used to derive the displayed label when label is omitted.

command.description: Executable used for the preflight step.

args.description: Arguments passed to the preflight command. Values are stringified at runtime.

cwd.description: Working directory for the preflight command. Defaults to the parent service cwd.

env.description: Extra environment variables merged into the spawned preflight process.

service.description: Runnable development service exposed to imperia-cli and VS Code tasks.

commandName.description: Stable service identifier used for task generation, persisted selection state and CLI dispatch.

description.description: Longer text shown in command listings. Defaults to commandName.

title.description: Short label shown in the interactive service selector. Defaults to commandName.

repoKey.description: Repository key that owns this service. Must match one of the entries in repositories[].key.

runtime.description: Optional runtime badge shown in the selector and metadata output.

ports.description: Ports managed by the service. imperia-cli uses them to stop conflicting local processes before launch.

cwd.description: Working directory used to start the service. Defaults to the root of the referenced repository.

env.description: Extra environment variables merged into the service process.

command.description: Executable used to start the service.

args.description: Arguments passed to the service command. Values are stringified at runtime.

preflightTitle.description: Custom heading displayed while executing the preflight steps. If omitted, imperia-cli shows 'Preparing <title>.'

preflight.description: Ordered preflight steps executed before the service starts.
